Baseline Governance

Capture and manage project baselines. Track changes against approved baselines and request baseline change approvals.

baselines

API router for Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB) governance.

This router provides endpoints for freezing baselines, comparing live WBS state against frozen baselines, and managing Baseline Change Requests (BCRs).

Endpoints

POST /api/v1/baselines/freeze — Freeze a new baseline snapshot. GET /api/v1/baselines/compare — Compare live state against a baseline. GET /api/v1/baselines/list — List baselines for a project. POST /api/v1/baselines/bcr — Create a new Baseline Change Request. PUT /api/v1/baselines/bcr/{id} — Update BCR status (approve/reject). GET /api/v1/baselines/bcr/{id} — Get BCR details. GET /api/v1/baselines/bcr — List BCRs by status/tier.

Sub-Tree Locking

The POST /freeze endpoint acquires a sub-tree lock before cloning the live WBS sub-tree into baseline snapshot rows. This prevents concurrent mutations from changing the source tree during the snapshot. If a lock is already held, HTTP 423 (Locked) is returned.

Security

All endpoints require JWT authentication. The authenticated user must have sufficient clearance to access the portfolio nodes involved.

Usage

# Freeze a new baseline POST /api/v1/baselines/freeze { “root_node_id”: “<uuid>”, “baseline_code”: “B0_CONTRACT”, “name”: “Contract Baseline” }

# Compare live state against a baseline GET /api/v1/baselines/compare?root_node_id=<uuid>&baseline_id=<uuid>

# Create a BCR POST /api/v1/baselines/bcr { “bcr_number”: “BCR-2024-001”, “title”: “Extend delivery schedule”, “justification”: “Supply chain delays…”, “tier”: “TIER_2_PROJECT_CCB”, “schedule_finish_slip_days”: 14 }

What You Can Do

Viewing Information

  • View: Compare live WBS state against a frozen baseline.

  • View: List all baselines for a given portfolio project.

  • View: List Baseline Change Requests, optionally filtered by status or tier.

  • View: Get details of a specific Baseline Change Request.

Creating New Items

  • Create: Freeze a new Performance Measurement Baseline.

  • Create: Create a new Baseline Change Request.

Updating Information

  • Update: Update the status of a Baseline Change Request.
